title: [Revert]: nixos/traefik: refactor due to issues with complex config
reason: FLAGGED REAL REVERT (coordinator: 'check whether reverted content genuinely returns to base-equivalent state or something subtler'). Base has the prior refactor: static.{file,settings} / dynamic.{file,dir,files,settings} nested options with 6 real assertions and mkRenamedOptionModule shims for the OLDER flat names. Head is NOT a bare git-revert of that refactor commit -- it is a fresh, independently-written flat module: static.{file,settings} and dynamic.{file,dir,files,settings} are ALL GONE (no mkRenamedOptionModule shims at all, a genuine removal, not a rename-back), replaced by flat staticConfigFile/staticConfigOptions/dynamicConfigFile/dynamicConfigOptions (matching pre-refactor naming but with different internal plumbing: TOML format instead of JSON, no 'user' option -- hardcoded to 'traefik' now, systemd hardening settings changed e.g. ProtectSystem 'strict'->'full', TasksMax->LimitNPROC, Type notify->simple). Consuming module pangolin.nix updates in lockstep: supplementaryGroups->group, static.settings->staticConfigOptions, dynamic.files.'pangolin'.settings->dynamicConfigOptions.
targets_toml: TWO targets under this PR: (1) traefik.nix itself, option_prefix=[services,traefik], watch=[staticConfigFile]; (2) pangolin.nix's consuming-side change, option_prefix=[services,traefik] (same prefix, cross-referenced from pangolin's config), watch=[group].

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: REAL ACTIONABLE FINDING on the REVERT itself: staticConfigFile is a real option in the post-revert (head) module, predicate exists (if cfg.staticConfigFile == null then...), predicate_attempts witnessed=false, default_outcome=true. This is exactly the scrutiny the coordinator asked for -- the revert reintroduces a real option whose branch coverage is untested, mechanically identical to any other new-option OBA001 case, not a rename or shim, since the pre-refactor mkRenamedOptionModule compat shims are ALSO gone in this revert (no soft landing for anyone who adopted the intermediate refactor's static/dynamic naming).

'unchanged' both sides: pangolin.nix's real supplementaryGroups->group migration doesn't materially change traefik.nix's own option-branch discoverability for 'group' (which existed at both base and head as a plain mkOption, unaffected by the revert). No gap.
